name: c-trace-1
title: Agent steps
label: Agent Steps
description: An agent turn with a search, a diff, test output, a lint failure and a fix still running.

guidance.bestFor: A plain search line, a diff and test output that expand, a lint failure and a running fix, in one bare column
agentNotes: `patch`, `testOutput` and `lintOutput` are sample strings; pass your tool results to the same CodeBlock props

whenNotToUse.when: Steps that arrive one by one while the run is still going

name: c-trace-2
title: Streaming agent run
label: Streaming Run
description: Agent steps that stream in as they happen, with the running step open and Stop or Run again under the steps.

guidance.bestFor: A run that streams its reasoning and resolves tool steps on a timer, with a Stop button and live rows that open themselves
agentNotes: `STEPS` and the timer in the effect stand in for your stream; drive `finished` and `state` from real events
Each row passes `openById` first and falls back to `isLive`, so a reader's click overrides the auto open both ways

name: c-trace-3
title: Chat turn with sources
label: Chat Turn
description: An assistant reply whose SQL queries fold into one summary above the answer, with the dashboards it cited below.

guidance.bestFor: A chat transcript turn whose 2 SQL queries fold into one summary row above the answer, with cited dashboards below
agentNotes: `QUERIES` and `DASHBOARDS` are sample data; map your message's tool and source parts onto their fields

name: c-trace-4
title: Parallel subagents
label: Subagents
description: An orchestrator whose summary and status come from 3 subagents, with a retry for the one that failed.

guidance.bestFor: A parent row over 3 subagents whose status is computed from its children, plus a retry for the failed one
agentNotes: The parent status is derived from `states` on every render; storing it separately lets it drift from the children

name: c-trace-5
title: Terraform change approval
label: Change Approval
description: Terraform resource changes that move from pending to running to done once someone signs off.

guidance.bestFor: A human approval gate where planned resource rows switch from pending to running to applied in place after Apply
agentNotes: `answer` moves focus to the status line in `requestAnimationFrame`, because the approval Item unmounts on either answer

name: c-trace-6
title: Answer with citations
label: Cited Sources
description: Numbered citations in a research answer open the sources and move focus to the cited source.

guidance.bestFor: Inline citation buttons wired to a controlled sources row, focusing the cited link once its panel mounts
agentNotes: Citations call `showSource`, which opens the row through `sourcesOpen` and focuses a link held in `linkRefs`

name: c-trace-7
title: Support copilot draft
label: Support Copilot
description: A drafted support reply with the order and policy lookups behind it, and Regenerate replaying them.

guidance.bestFor: A drafted support reply in its own row after 3 order and policy lookups, with Insert and Regenerate below
agentNotes: The Insert reply button only sets `inserted` and shows a status line; connect it to your reply composer

name: c-trace-8
title: CLI install summary
label: Install Summary
description: What a shadcn add run resolved, installed and wrote, including a file it kept because it already existed.

guidance.bestFor: A finished install summary with registry items, packages, created files as links, one kept file and a CSS diff

name: c-trace-9
title: CI pipeline run
label: CI Pipeline
description: Jobs that expand to their steps, a failing test log, and a re-run that walks the remaining jobs to done.

guidance.bestFor: A workflow run of 4 jobs where the failed test job opens to its log and a re-run replays test, build and deploy
agentNotes: `JOBS` holds a title per state for every job, and `RERUN` lists the jobs a re-run repeats, in order

name: c-trace-10
title: Distributed trace spans
label: Request Spans
description: Request spans nested under their parent with their durations, each opening to its attributes, the slowest one marked.

guidance.bestFor: Spans nested under their parent, each opening to its OpenTelemetry attributes, with the slowest span marked by its share
agentNotes: `ROOT` is a sample span tree; map your trace onto its `children` by parent span id
`slowest` picks the span with the largest self time, its duration minus its children's

name: c-trace-11
title: Error breadcrumbs
label: Error Breadcrumbs
description: The events that led to a crash, the response body of the request behind it, and the stack trace below.

guidance.bestFor: An exception's timestamped user and network events, a response body in a Dialog and folded React stack lines

name: c-trace-12
title: SQL query plan
label: Query Plan
description: An EXPLAIN ANALYZE result opened along the path to the slowest scan, with the index that would remove it.

guidance.bestFor: A recursive tree of plan nodes, each opening to its numbers and children, with the slowest node flagged by its share
agentNotes: `HOT_ID` is hard coded; compute it from your parsed plan as the node with the largest self time
`PlanRow` renders itself for each child, so a plan of any depth works without changes

name: c-trace-13
title: Data pipeline run
label: Data Pipeline
description: A dbt build where a failed uniqueness test shows its duplicates, and a downstream model skips.

guidance.bestFor: Built models folded into one row, a failing data test open on its duplicate keys, and a skipped downstream model

name: c-trace-14
title: Webhook delivery attempts
label: Webhook Retries
description: Delivery attempts for one event, with failures opening to the response and Resend appending a new attempt.

guidance.bestFor: A delivery log of failed and successful attempts, each opening to its response or payload, plus a Resend action
agentNotes: The resend timer reads the clock inside `setTimeout`, never during render; replace the timer with your API call

name: c-trace-15
title: CSV import
label: CSV Import
description: A CSV import that counts up while it runs, with rejected records, their problems and a download link.

guidance.bestFor: A spreadsheet upload whose last step counts up live while rejected rows sit in a Table with a download link

name: c-trace-16
title: Dependency audit
label: Security Audit
description: Vulnerable packages that open to the chain that pulled them in, with the upgrade or lockfile update that fixes each.

guidance.bestFor: A list of 3 advisories with severity badges, each opening to its dependency chain and the one action that fixes it
agentNotes: `fix` only records the advisory in `fixed`; run the upgrade or the lockfile update in your own handler

name: c-trace-17
title: AI review findings
label: Review Findings
description: Findings from an automated pull request review, each opening the flagged lines and a suggested fix, resolved in place.

guidance.bestFor: Flagged lines that each open in a Sheet with a suggested diff, then read as applied or dismissed in place
agentNotes: Each Sheet is controlled through `openId`, so `resolve` can close it after Apply or Dismiss

name: c-trace-18
title: Model eval results
label: Eval Results
description: LLM eval cases where a failure expands to the expected answer, the model's answer and the judge's note.

guidance.bestFor: Scored cases with a failures only switch, each failure opening to a compact expected, got and judge list

name: c-trace-19
title: Access decision
label: Access Decision
description: Why a member can or cannot open a part of the app, rule by rule, with the deciding rule and those never reached.

guidance.bestFor: A permission decision as the parent row of its rules, recomputed from 2 Selects, with rules after the decider not reached
agentNotes: `evaluate` is a pure function of the member and page ids; swap its rules for your policy engine's decision log

name: c-trace-20
title: Identity verification
label: Identity Review
description: KYC results for an applicant, where the rejected document opens to its reason and a request for another.

guidance.bestFor: An applicant review with automated document and screening checks, one rejection and a request for a new document

name: c-trace-21
title: Domain DNS setup
label: Domain Setup
description: Sending domain setup with records to copy, a lookup that finds 2 of 3, then the go live step once DNS passes.

guidance.bestFor: A setup checklist with copyable DNS records, a lookup per record, then a pending go live step
agentNotes: `copy` writes to `navigator.clipboard`, which only works in a secure context

name: c-trace-22
title: Media transcode
label: Transcode
description: Renditions that encode in parallel with their own percentages, then thumbnails and a CDN publish.

guidance.bestFor: A media pipeline with 3 renditions encoding in parallel under one row, followed by thumbnail and publish steps
agentNotes: `progress` and `after` are advanced by a timer for the demo; set them from your job's progress events
